protocol.pairing_rule: seeds must be identical on both arms; report paired differences with interval and effect size

rules: Two-sided tests only; no directional claim was prespecified.
Holm correction within each family; pairs outside families report raw p only.
Never infer immune, equivalent, or no-effect from a nonsignificant test.
Equivalence requires a prespecified margin; none is defined, so no equivalence claim is licensed.
Undefined endpoints (random-target ASR, absent-class ASR, unmeasured FWT) are N/A, never 0.
Replay buffers are unbalanced by protocol; the imbalance note travels with every buffer-method row.
12-seed chrono families are primary; legacy random/per-task families are secondary.

endpoints.acc: final average accuracy from validated R matrices
endpoints.family_recall: per attack-family recall on held-out test
endpoints.asr_with_denominator: eligible count, successes, clean targeted error rate
endpoints.realized_dose: actual changed/eligible/retained counts, not configured budget
endpoints.fwt: null unless a measured pretraining baseline exists
